name: Honda XR185 / XR200 (1979-1980)
engine: 180 or 195 cc air-cooled single, twin shock
intro: Small Honda off-road singles before the Pro-Link XR200R. Easy to ride and hard to kill.
recallNote: Off-road models are not always in the NHTSA recall search. Ask a Honda dealer to run the VIN as well.
